task: Interface translation (FR/AR) — decide whether the edition wants it at all
details: The EN/FR/AR control was removed from the nav earlier (see the comment in SiteNav.tsx): it was never wired, and it advertised two interface languages the site does not have. On 25 September the dead code behind it went too — LangSwitcher.tsx (rendered nowhere), src/lib/i18n.ts (UI_STRINGS and t(), imported by nothing), and the site-lang bootstrap in layout.tsx, which nothing could set any more but still flipped document direction for anyone who had pressed the old control. Nothing is half-built now. If the interface should be translated, it starts from a decision about which languages the EDITION serves — the content is Arabic with English translation in progress — not from restoring a dictionary nobody read.
